vocab.def: the fact of following what a rule requires
vocab.ex: The ship was in compliance with the rule.

vocab.def: legal responsibility for damage, loss or injury

vocab.def: the legal power a state has over a place, a ship or a person
vocab.ex: The ship is under the jurisdiction of her flag state.

vocab.def: an official change to a legal text
vocab.ex: The amendment started eighteen months after it was adopted.

vocab.def: the official act by which a state accepts a treaty
vocab.ex: Ratification by thirty states was needed.

vocab.def: an extra section of a convention with the detailed technical rules
vocab.ex: The technical rules are in the annex.

vocab.def: an international agreement between states, such as SOLAS
vocab.ex: The convention gives the duties of flag states.

vocab.def: a later document that adds to or changes a convention
vocab.ex: The protocol of 1988 changed the survey rules.

vocab.def: one specific rule inside a legal text
vocab.ex: The port state checks this provision.

vocab.def: the act of making people obey a rule, with a penalty if they do not
vocab.ex: Enforcement belongs to the port state.

reading_sub: Questions first, then the text. Use the glossary.

paras: A convention does not become law on the day it is adopted. It becomes law on a ship only when the flag state ratifies it and then writes it into its own national law. For this reason, two identical ships at the same berth can follow different rules.

Here is a typical case. The ship was registered in a state which had ratified the convention, but not the later protocol. The classification society to which the owner sent the surveys worked for that flag state only. Then the ship went to a port in another state. That state had ratified both the convention and the protocol, so its inspectors used a stricter standard.

It was not the surveyor who made a mistake, and it was not the master. What stopped the ship was an amendment that one state had accepted and the other had not. The certificate was valid under the law of the flag, but it was not enough under the law of the port.
The lesson is simple. Liability did not follow the person at fault; it followed the flag. And enforcement belonged to the state that controlled the water.

listenings.h: The Surveyor Who Was Not at Fault
listenings.sub: The man who signed the certificate explains his job. Sound first, no text.
listenings.text: Three different lawyers asked me the same question, and my answer is always the same. I surveyed that ship under the rules her flag state had accepted. Those are the only rules I am allowed to use. My authorisation comes from one state only. The port on the other side of the ocean had ratified a protocol that her flag state had not. That is not a mistake in my survey, and I cannot change it. The hard part for people is this: both certificates were valid. Mine was valid under the law of the flag. Theirs was valid under the law of the port. And in the port, the law of the port always wins.
questions: Which rules did he use for the survey?
The rules her flag state had accepted.
How many states does his authorisation come from?
Which law wins in the port?
The law of the port. It always wins there.

grammar_tip_lead: A cleft points at one thing: It was X who..., What ... was X. A relative clause says which one: the state whose flag..., the society to which.... You only need to read them and find the noun.

teacher.s1: Abertura (1 min): Aula no NIVEL NOVO (pedido da professora em 28/09): texto mais curto, frases simples, glossario na tela, 1 listening so e as respostas por ESCRITO. A prova e 100% leitura. Comeca o bloco 2. Clefts e oracoes relativas hoje sao para LER, nao para produzir.
teacher.s2: Homework check + warm-up (4 min): Ela le UMA das cinco frases que escreveu e escolhe um chip. Uma frase basta. Anote erro de colocacao para o capitulo 5.
teacher.s3: Provocacao (3 min): Ela escolhe A ou B. Espere 5 segundos. Resposta: B (um navio nao e registrado numa autoridade portuaria). Depois pergunte, com opcoes: is the clause about the port authority or about a state?
teacher.s4: Objetivo (1 min): Leia as tres missoes. Diga: today you answer in writing.
teacher.s5: Transicao vocab (1 min): Diga: Ten words of the law. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s6: Vocab reveal 1-4 (4 min): compliance, liability, jurisdiction, amendment. NAO traduza. CCQ com opcoes: Liability: is it the same as fault, yes or no? (No: no texto, liability seguiu a bandeira.)
teacher.s7: Vocab reveal 5-7 (4 min): ratification, annex, convention. CCQ com opcoes: Where are the technical rules: in the articles or in the annex? (In the annex.)
teacher.s8: Vocab reveal 8-10 (4 min): protocol, provision, enforcement. CCQ com opcoes: Is a protocol a new convention or a change to a convention? (A change.)
teacher.s9: Consolidate (3 min): Ela liga os pares sozinha. Ajude so se ela pedir.
teacher.s10: Transicao leitura (1 min): Diga: One ship, two states. O proximo slide e o de TAREFA: a pergunta ANTES do texto.
teacher.s11: Leitura (7 min): Leitura silenciosa. Mostre o GLOSSARIO antes. Releitura de frase e normal. Se ela travar numa palavra fora do glossario, de um sinonimo simples em ingles.
teacher.s12: Gist (2 min): Ela escolhe a opcao e ESCREVE a linha que prova. Resposta: (a). A (c) e a leitura intuitiva e errada.
teacher.s13: True or False (5 min): Ela responde as cinco e escreve a linha que prova cada uma. A 5 troca FLAG state por PORT state: e o erro de referencia que a aula treina.
teacher.s14: Transicao gramatica (1 min): Diga: Two structures from the text. You only need to read them. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s15: Grammar discovery (6 min): Peca que ela ESCREVA a versao simples dos exemplos 1 e 2. Nos exemplos 3 e 4, ela escreve a QUE substantivo a oracao se refere. So entao clique Reveal the Rule. CCQ com opcoes: in a state which had ratified both, which is the state or the port? (The state.)
teacher.s16: Practice (4 min): Ela escreve a versao simples ANTES de clicar. Aceite qualquer versao simples correta.
teacher.s17: Spot the error (3 min): which por who com pessoa, concordancia (was), pronome repetido depois da preposicao, e which flag por whose flag.
teacher.s18: Transicao equivalencia (1 min): Diga: Same case, other words. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s19: Como a prova esconde (3 min): Leia os quatro pares com ela. O quarto (liability followed the flag) e o que muda QUEM responde.
teacher.s20: Equivalencia (4 min): Ela liga os pares. Ajude so depois de 5 segundos.
teacher.s21: Complete (4 min): Uma lacuna por vez. As oito respostas estao no banco de palavras.
teacher.s22: Quick fire POR ESCRITO (6 min): Ela escreve a resposta de cada uma no chat ou no papel, e so depois voces abrem as dicas. A segunda treina o defeito do slide 3.
teacher.s23: Transicao (1 min): Diga: One recording, then you write. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s24: Listening (5 min): O UNICO listening da aula (pedido da professora). LEIA AS 3 PERGUNTAS EM VOZ ALTA COM ELA ANTES de tocar. Primeira vez em 0.75x, segunda em 1x. No fim pergunte, com opcoes: were both certificates valid, yes or no? (Yes.)
teacher.s25: Writing (5 min): Ela escreve tres frases sobre o vistoriador, uma por inicio. Corrija por escrito so o essencial (verbo e palavra tecnica). Depois clique Show a Model Answer.
teacher.s26: Escrita guiada (5 min): Quatro frases com os inicios. Conte quantas oracoes relativas ela usa certo, sem exigir.
teacher.s27: Escrita semi-livre (5 min): Para cada oracao, ela escreve o substantivo. Porque faz sentido nao basta: peca o criterio (sentido ou concordancia).
teacher.s28: Producao (4 min): Ela ESCREVE tres frases para o comandante e depois LE em voz alta. Esse e o unico momento de fala da fase: curto e com roteiro.
teacher.s29: Transicao wrap-up (1 min): Diga: Let us see what you can do now.
teacher.s30: Survival card (3 min): Cinco frases do texto. Toque e peca repeticao, uma vez cada. Pronuncia: liability (lai-a-BIL-i-ti) e jurisdiction (jur-is-DIC-shun).
teacher.s31: Checklist (2 min): Leia cada item em voz alta. Os 5 checks fecham a aula e acendem o stamp.
teacher.s32: Encerramento (2 min): Diga: Lesson 6 complete, Helena. HOMEWORK ORALMENTE, nunca escrito na tela: (1) num paragrafo curto de uma convencao da IMO em ingles, sublinhar tres oracoes relativas e escrever ao lado o substantivo de cada uma; (2) escrever tres frases simples da rotina dela e depois a mesma frase com It was... who.
